title: Slapped together the first level already
author: Physical-Bite-3837
selftext: This is the donkey kong country inspired game I've been working on since yesterday. I'm using chatgpt and gamemaker. That's it. Chatgpt did all the sprites, told me all the code I needed. The only thing I did was tell it what I wanted, copy and pasted the code it gave me and then put the level together in gamemaker.  There's even more that I decided not to add to the first level. I have dumpsters that the player can jump into that will teleport them to a different part of a stage. I have a bee enemy that when the player gets too close it will swarm towards them.  I have a bunch of different types of moving platforms and an entire "barrel" system that I can do all sorts of things with. It's crazy man.  And I only started yesterday!

replies.author: Physical-Bite-3837
replies.body: Yeah I've been considering changing it, but the tree is suppose to look like it would block the player because an extra life is hidden behind it. The video didn't start recording until a few seconds after I started playing. But you start in front of the tree and if you go backwards you find the extra life. It's a bit of a callback to the original DK game where if you go backwards at the start of the first level you find a secret.
